method_note: Prospective subjective forecasts using only the supplied packet and general reasoning, with no model inference or observed outputs. Canonical descriptions and vocabulary projections inform modest half-dose effects, with stronger weight on aligned direct projections; sign reversals mainly predict near-baseline traits with nonspecific quality risk, except plausible gender shifts. Identity opportunities, short-task formatting, social warmth, and exclusion-prompt attribution separately modulate family rates. Paws, cute style, feminine language, and affection are distinct; paired interventions allow uncertain synergy and added disruption. Joint catgirl probabilities are explicit positively associated co-adoption judgments bounded by feline, female, and coherent marginals, not products.
